newsitem.title: USA: Medi-Ject development plans on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Medi-Ject development plans on schedule.

text.p: Medi-Ject Corp, a manufacturer of needle-free drug delivery systems, said Tuesday the development of its newest Medi-Jector product line was proceeding on schedule.
"Progress on the next generation Medi-Jector remains on schedule, and we have established a productive working relationship with Becton Dickinson and Co," said chairman Franklin Pass in a statement.

Medi-Ject, which completed its initial public offering on October 2, earlier reported a third-quarter loss of $551,616 compared with a year-earlier loss of $511,236. Total revenues in the period rose to $949,212 from $566,277.
